turns.question: Which call topic had the highest objection rate in September 2026, and what was that rate?
turns.answer: The returns call topic had the highest objection rate in September 2026, at 72.7% (0.727) of labelled calls for 1 to 30 September 2026. Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
